questionText: What is the Spring Boot parent POM and why do projects use it?

target.learningOutcome: The learner can explain what the Spring Boot Maven parent provides, distinguish dependency management from dependencies, and choose the imported BOM when another parent must remain.
outOfScope: A claim that the parent downloads web libraries
A claim that the parent is mandatory

claims.statement: The Spring Boot starter parent supplies dependency management and useful Maven build and plugin defaults to child projects.
Dependency management supplies selected versions when matching dependencies are declared; the parent does not add a web, data, or test dependency by itself.
When the Spring Boot starter parent is used, the repackage execution is preconfigured, while the project still declares the Spring Boot Maven plugin.
A project that cannot use the Spring Boot parent can import spring-boot-dependencies for dependency management, but that import does not provide the parent's plugin management.

examples.title: Maven POM with Spring Boot 3.3.1 parent, Java 17, web starter, and Boot plugin

validation.command: Extract the XML fence and parse it with Python xml.etree.ElementTree
validation.expected: The focused POM is well-formed XML with a versionless web starter and declared Boot plugin

visuals.title: Spring Boot parent, imported BOM, and starter responsibilities

notes: The lesson is explicitly Maven-scoped and does not transfer parent-POM language to Gradle.

review.notes: Parent, BOM, dependency-management, and repackage configuration claims were checked against Spring Boot 3.3.1 documentation; XML well-formedness was parsed independently.
